name: Com lam
summary: Cơm lam is sticky rice cooked inside a length of bamboo, sold at the Silver Waterfall stalls and on the town grills. Peel back the tube to get at the rice.
origin: Upland Vietnam. In Sa Pa it sits on the grills with corn, eggs, and sweet potato.
howToEat: Peel the bamboo away and eat the rice straight from the tube.
where: The tree stalls under Silver Waterfall, about 12 km from town toward Ô Quy Hồ. Also on the cold-night grills at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market.
seoTitle: Com lam in Sapa — sticky rice in bamboo
seoDescription: Cơm lam, sticky rice cooked in bamboo, at the Silver Waterfall stalls and the cold-night grills by hồ Sa Pa.
